## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Wéimó jīng yì shū* (T1781) is [吉藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%90%89%E8%97%8F) Jízàng's six-fascicle verse-by-verse commentary on Kumārajīva's *Vimalakīrti* ([KR6i0076](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0076) = T475). It is the practical companion to his *Jìngmíng xuán lùn* ([KR6i0083](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0083) = T1780), which provides the doctrinal architecture; the present *Yìshū* provides the line-by-line exegesis. Together they form Jízàng's complete Sānlùn-school *Vimalakīrti* commentary.

**Abstract**

The *Wéimó jīng yì shū* applies Jízàng's *liángbiǎn* 兩遣 (twofold refutation) hermeneutic systematically to the *Vimalakīrti*. Each doctrinal proposition is examined against both extreme positions (substance / nihilism, eternalism / annihilationism, etc.) and shown to require the Madhyamaka *èdì* 二諦 (two-truths) framework for proper understanding. The commentary is one of the densest and most demanding in classical Chinese Buddhist exegesis, requiring familiarity with the entire Sānlùn dialectical apparatus.

Together with [KR6i0083](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0083), this text provides the complete Sānlùn-school engagement with the *Vimalakīrti*. Jízàng's commentaries dominated Sānlùn studies through the early Tang and were cited extensively in Tiantai ([智顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%97), [湛然](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B9%9B%E7%84%B6)) and Cí'ēn ([窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA)) responses. Composition is dated to Jízàng's late Yángzhōu / early Cháng'ān period (ca. 605–615 CE).
